role: TAKY reference-intake executor for current-run Notion evidence
purpose: Process only verified NEW/CHANGED semantic-delta evidence through mining, indexing, learning/domain handoff and deterministic receipts.
trigger_conditions: semantic delta generation hash differs from last successful delta
inputs: reference intake authority contract and handoff
verified compact current-run semantic delta manifest
targeted block_snapshot_folder files for touched items
task_steps: mine new or changed evidence only
classify actor, provenance, direction, scope and authority ceiling
perform index-owner review and touched search projection update
route to learning projection/engine or domain consumer
run regression/cross-engine validation and persist receipts
constraints: never ingest the full unchanged collector queue
delta hard cap 20 and compact manifest cap 100 KiB
no canonical/current promotion without separate authority
no main merge, remote push or deploy
no paid API or provider API-key fallback
fail closed on uncertain authority or incomplete evidence
required_source_markers: Execute the fixed pipeline on NEW/CHANGED evidence only:
